h1: Modern Classic apartment interior design in London, furniture and turnkey renovation, 120 m²

blocks.text: Modern Classic apartment interior design in London, furniture and turnkey renovation, 120 m²

parts.html: A 120 m² apartment in London in a contemporary classic style. The studio did the interior design project with 3D visualization and technical documentation, the custom furniture and a turnkey renovation; the project is complete. Before work started, the client received a detailed cost estimate for the work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures and lighting.

The classic side shows in the proportions and finishes: wall moldings, multi-level ceilings with cornices, herringbone parquet, marble-look tile. The layout is modern, with a shared kitchen-living room, and the lighting is built from several scenarios: chandeliers, concealed ceiling lighting, linear fixtures and wall sconces.

The living room, dining room and kitchen take up one space along the windows. Above the sofa hangs a large chandelier of brass branches with crystal drops. Opposite is the TV wall with a built-in fireplace, clad in large slabs of dark marble. It is flanked by wood slats and crystal sconces, followed by white walls with moldings and built-in shelving. The floor combines two materials: herringbone parquet in the seating area and large marble-look tile around it, with a thin brass strip marking the border between them.

The kitchen has glossy white tall units up to the ceiling, while the upper cabinets and the island are clad in walnut veneer laid in a herringbone pattern. The countertop and backsplash are light veined stone. The tall units house an oven, a coffee machine and a wine cooler, and next to them are two glass display cabinets behind white latticework. A row of slim brass pendants hangs above the island.

In the bedroom, the wardrobe fronts are finished in the same herringbone walnut veneer as the kitchen, and between the wardrobe and the window stands a column with a molding and a vertical light. The second bedroom has full-wall wardrobes with white fronts and a pattern of thin lines, with a desk by the window. The study has an upholstered sofa, a dark wood shelving unit and a desk by the window.

The entrance hall walls are finished in textured plaster, and the floor is white marble-look tile with a gray border. Built-in wardrobes with white fronts and brass handles line one wall; opposite are a console with a pouf and a mirror.
